data.name: Anilkumar
data.gender_notes: Anilkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anilkumar is a name derived from Sanskrit words 'Anil' which means wind and 'Kumar' which means younger brother. This name is often given to a younger brother born in the family during a time when the wind is blowing. In Hindu mythology, the wind god, Anil, is known to be powerful and free-willed. The name Anilkumar signifies the arrival of a new, young, and free-willed member in the family.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringer of new wind and change
data.etymology: Anilkumar belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Anil (wind) and Kumar (younger brother).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anilkumar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
